entries.question: What do the Summer Madness XVI accusations - Hollow Da Don vs Nu Jerzey Twork, Calicoe on Brizz Rawsteen - say about accountability and respect in battle rap right now?
entries.stance: Accountability in battle rap is a performance, not a policy, and respect is a variable that shifts based on who has the mic.
said: King, you think stepping up cleans the slate? Twork stepped up in Houston, got his whole life unpacked like luggage. Brizz stepped away, got a whole narrative built around trauma.
King, you just said the slate gets cleaned by the battle. But Hollow didn't battle Twork's charges...he performed them. And Calicoe didn't battle Brizz...he built him a shrine called 'trauma.
Tasha, you keep talking about money like it proves something. It doesn't. Hollow's out here airing Twork's whole life for sport, and Calicoe's whispering Brizz is shook for clicks.
entries.closing: King, you just said the slate gets cleaned by the battle. But Hollow didn't battle Twork's charges...he performed them. And Calicoe didn't battle Brizz...he built him a shrine called 'trauma.

entries.question: Is Brizz Rawsteen genuinely traumatized and done with battling, or not?
entries.stance: Brizz Rawsteen is using the 'trauma' narrative as a calculated excuse to avoid the grind of battling while still profiting from the culture.
said: King, you just made my point wearing a halo. That handshake you see? It's a contract he won't sign in the ring. Calicoe said Brizz ran from Moo...now he's running the room instead.
A performance, Tasha? A performance. Okay. Calicoe said Brizz was 'tripping' when Moo announced that battle. Said he was scared. Said he ran. That's not method acting, my man...
The invoice is zero, Tasha. 'Cause the culture already paid. He cashed the check of our sympathy, then booked the stage at our events.
entries.closing: King, you just made my point wearing a halo. That handshake you see? It's a contract he won't sign in the ring. Calicoe said Brizz ran from Moo...now he's running the room instead.
